selection_note: Three refreshed identity-only candidates were replaced with clearer technical evidence. No level or Hold decisions applied.

records.title: Blacker and Blues
demands: CDMC specifies one alto saxophone with piano accompaniment, so pianist coordination is part of this edition’s performing context.
CDMC catalogs seven pages and indexes the work under blues and original repertoire. No actual swing, articulation or range requirement has been verified.
records.scope: No notation inspected. The seven-page extent is library metadata. Public searches located no authorized notation preview or exact playback. Rhythms, register, stamina and movement structure remain unknown.
records.recording_description: No exact public recording verified. A Tyrol 2009 competition program documents a performance, without providing playback.
records.identity_caveat: CDMC publication year is 1982. This has not been established separately as the composition year. Studio Music product identifier M-050-03325-7 is corroborated by retailer indexing.

evidence.claim: Exact title, Cowles, E-flat alto and piano, Studio Music London 1982, seven pages
